newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to promote EU stability council -- Arthuis.
newsitem.headline: France to promote EU stability council -- Arthuis.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Tuesday that France planned to promote in the coming months its idea of setting up a European Union council to coordinate economic policies under a single currency.
"This stability and growth council will be an absolute necessity," he told a New Year ceremony for the press.
France has said it wants such a council to be set up among countries in monetary union at the start to act as a counterbalance to the future European Central Bank.
The idea, which appears to be gaining acceptance among France's EU partners, would be to set up an informal council similar to the Group of Seven leading industrial nations.
Arthuis also reaffirmed that France would be ready to join monetary union on January 1, 1999.
